literal: Their belly they will not fill, distress they will suffer, those who are enveloped by the goddess of misfortune called gambling.
translation: Those who are enveloped by the goddess of misfortune called gambling will not even fill their bellies, and will suffer endless distress.
modern: சூது என்று சொல்லப்படும் மூதேவியால் (வறுமைத் தெய்வத்தால்) மூடப்பட்டவர்கள், தம் வயிற்றைக்கூட நிரப்ப முடியாமல் துன்பத்தை அடைவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet warns against the devastating effects of gambling by personifying it as the goddess of misfortune. Those who fall into the trap of gambling are described as being completely enveloped or possessed by this destructive force. As a result, they lose everything, to the extent that they cannot even satisfy their basic hunger. Instead of wealth or pleasure, they are left to endure constant misery and distress.
